description: Stop RepuTend tracking one of your account's businesses, on every review site. Its reviews, screening results and decided cases are kept, and adding it back later starts from them. If Attack Mode is on for it, it is turned off, and its charge stays on the next invoice. Refused while the business has open cases, and for the account's only business: to stop RepuTend altogether, the owner cancels the subscription. What a person may say: "stop tracking example.com".

business.description: The business to act on, by its domain (such as example.com), one of those list_businesses shows. Needed only when your accounts track more than one business.

name: remove_business
title: Remove a business
